skill_card.name: API Contract Analyzer
skill_card.description: Extracts normalized, deterministic API contracts from OpenAPI 3.x, Swagger 2.0, or JSON Schema specifications for downstream test design, coverage analysis, and requirement traceability.

tasks.name: Parse and normalize API specifications
tasks.description: Parses OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0 YAML/JSON documents into normalized HTTP operations, endpoints, parameters, and schema constraints.
tasks.output_schema: Normalized API contract model conforming to schema templates.

tasks.name: Extract field constraints and validation rules
tasks.description: Extracts data types, formats, regex patterns, enum bounds, and discriminators into structured field constraints.
tasks.output_schema: Structured field constraints and validation rules object.

tasks.name: Generate gaps report and traceability links
tasks.description: Identifies missing response schemas, unresolvable circular references, incomplete endpoints, and assigns deterministic traceability links.
tasks.output_schema: Actionable gaps report and operation-level traceability links.
